thread:
alice: Planning a phased soft-unpin of runtime-v2.16 next Tue 2026-04-07. Goal: remove pin from non-reserved pools to measure tail improvements. Pushing draft plan for signoff.

deploy-bot: Current pins: runtime-v2.16 -> eu-west-reserved, na-committed, onprem-legacy. Canary set: canary-eu/15 (v2.16), canary-us/10 (v2.16).

benjamin: Important: several customers pinned in eu-west-reserved are on legacy routing. We should not touch their pools or we trigger billing tickets.

carla: Proposed sequence: (A) 02:30 UTC: unpin canary-us only; (B) 04:00 UTC: unpin na-committed; (C) 08:00 UTC: evaluate eu-west-reserved rollback or partial unpin. Each step has a 90m observation window.

alice: Rollback criteria? Need concrete numbers and playbook steps.

dominic: From perf lab results, expected p95 drop ~10% but some variance in longseq. I recommend rollback if p95 deteriorates >25% from baseline or user-facing error_rate >0.4% sustained >5m. Also rollback on any memory OOM in runtime pods.

ops_kate: Add a routing hold for high-SLA customers: routing tag 'enterprise-lock' routes to reserved nodes that won't be unpinned. We'll flip that on before eu-west step. Also notify Support & Account owners 6h prior.

deploy-bot: Suggested CLI to schedule partial unpin:
`deployctl pin update --service runtime --version v2.16 --remove --pools canary-us --start 2026-04-07T02:30:00Z --observe 90m --owner alice`
And to set hold for enterprise customers:
`routingctl set-policy --name enterprise-lock --action hold --pools eu-west-reserved`
I will not touch eu-west-reserved without explicit opt-in.

benjamin: I'll draft the support template. Wording suggestion: "We plan a staged unpin of runtime-v2.16 from non-reserved pools on Tue 2026-04-07. Reserved enterprise capacity will be preserved initially. We will monitor latency and error metrics; Support will surface any customer impact immediately."

carla: Add eval traffic checks: run perf-regression test suite 'longseq-rerank' before each phase and after 30m. If quality metric (MRR) drops >1.5% abort.

alice: Good catch. Also include release-note snippet under runtime changelog: "v2.16 staged unpin (non-reserved), monitoring p95/p99 and quality evals; enterprise pools deferred."

dominic: Ops runbook: if rollback triggered run `/deploybot rollback --service runtime --target v2.15 --reason perf-regression --since 3340001112` then immediately set routingctl policy to re-route enterprise traffic back to pinned pools. Postmortem steps: capture heap/profile dumps and open an infra ticket.

ops_kate: I'll coordinate Support/CS notifications and create a short KB article for impacted CSMs. Also will add a runbook card to the incident playbook.

alice: Final checklist before schedule: 1) deployctl commands ready 2) telemetry alerts: p95 delta >25% OR p99 > 350ms OR errors +0.4% -> pager 3) perf-eval job wired 4) Support notified. If no objections by EOD PT I'll schedule.

benjamin: No objections. I'll push the support note after review.

carla: Watching perf-eval job as owner. I'll abort if MRR drops or KV miss spikes.

deploy-bot: Queue created. Example schedule command to run when you want to commit:
`deployctl schedule --action unpin --service runtime --version v2.16 --pools canary-us,na-committed --start 2026-04-07T02:30:00Z --observe 90m --owner alice`
I'll report status as each phase starts and finishes.

alice: Thanks team. I'll schedule after Support signoff and will post the release-note PR.

ops_kate: Support notified and CSMs looped. I'll post the KB link here once live.

alice: All set for now. We'll reconvene in the morning if anything changes.
